'''Kailage Lanis''' was a [[Gender/Legends|woman]] who was a member of the [[Friends of Paran]] resistance group on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Derilyn]]. She was good friends with [[Sneeze]], and although she seemed reserved, her skills at the controls of a [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] showed how daring she was.
